plan.summary: Zoho P4.1 — Stage Mapping editor full state coverage. (1) Yeni Integrations endpoint GET /api/v1/zoho/lead-statuses /settings/fields parse Lead_Status pick_list_values (5-dk per-tenant cache). (2) GetAllBlueprintTransitionsAsync picklist-driven sampling: her state icin COQL one-lead-per-state probe (existing 50-lead grouping fallback yerine). (3) Backend proxy GET /api/v1/zoho/lead-statuses (mevcut JwtAuth zaten /api/v1/zoho/* prefix). (4) Dashboard ZohoStageMappingPage: per-row dropdown + 'Manuel ID gir' toggle + 19-digit numeric format check + dropdown secimlerinde dry-run pre-validate (existing test endpoint), manuel secimlerde format-only. plan.q_intent: Q: 'P4.1 ile state-independent transition enumeration yap. Şu an editor sadece 3 transition gösteriyor (sample lead'in current state'inden); diger state'ler icin manuel ID girilebilmeli. Lead_Status picklist'inden (lead durumlarindan degil ASIL listeden) enum.' Q'nun interview onayi: full 3-katman, dropdown+manuel UI, dry-run pre-check, 5-dk cache, AC6 error fallback.
plan.interview_notes: Q kararlari: (a) Full 3-katman scope: picklist + COQL + blueprint harvest. (b) UI: dropdown + manuel input yanyana toggle. (c) Dry-run = mevcut /stage-mappings/test endpoint (whitelist check); manuel ID'ler format-only validation (whitelist'te olmayabilir cunku state-with-no-lead). (d) Cache: IMemoryCache 5-dk per-tenant, key zoho:lead-statuses:{tid}, connection update/disconnect'te clear. (e) Empty state UX: lead'i olmayan state'ler info banner'da listelenir, manuel input'la cozulur. (f) AC6: /settings/fields fail = banner + manuel-only fallback mode (dropdown disable, manuel input aktif, dry-run skip).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Lead_Status picklist endpoint dedicated (/api/v1/zoho/lead-statuses) — blueprint/transitions endpoint'i ile birlestirme YOK.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Iki endpoint farkli semantik: lead-statuses = picklist metadata (enum); blueprint/transitions = state-bagimsiz transition graph (harvested). Cache TTL'leri farkli (5-dk vs 10-dk; picklist daha az degisken degil ama kullanim pattern'i siklik bakima daha az cevrim). UI iki endpoint'i ayri konularda kullaniyor (info banner vs dropdown). Birlestirilmis endpoint scope creep + cache invalidation karmaşası.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ4/CQ8 'iki endpoint birlestirilebilir' diyebilir. Kabul: ayri semantic, ayri cache, ayri UX surface; tek endpoint icin REST surface daralmasi marjinal yarar.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Manuel transition ID input dry-run pre-check skip — sadece 19-digit numeric format kontrol.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Dry-run /stage-mappings/test endpoint'i blueprint whitelist check yapiyor; whitelist GetAllBlueprintTransitionsAsync ile harvested. State-with-no-lead'in transition'lari whitelist'te yok (Zoho API limitation: per-record blueprint sadece o lead'in state'inden cikan transition'lari doner). Manuel ID UX'i bu durumlari hedefliyor — dry-run zorunlu olsa kullanim case'i kirilir. Zoho gercek sync sirasinda invalid ID reddederse INV-INT-122 surface eder (mevcut error path).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ1/CQ3 'manuel input validate edilmeli' diyebilir. Kabul: format check (19-digit numeric) + Zoho-side runtime validation yeterli; whitelist check by-design state-bound oldugundan manuel scope'unda anlamsiz.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: GetSampleLeadsViaPicklistAsync yeni helper — GetSampleLeadsPerStateAsync (50-lead grouping) yerine picklist-driven probe.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Mevcut GetSampleLeadsPerStateAsync /Leads?per_page=50 alip Lead_Status grupluyor — kismi coverage (en yeni 50 lead'in distinct state set'i). Picklist-driven: her olasi state icin COQL `SELECT id FROM Leads WHERE Lead_Status='X' LIMIT 1` — daha kapsamli (50 lead disindaki state'ler de bulunur ama o state'te lead VARSA). Tenant 5050 case'inde fark yok (sadece Contacted'ta lead var) ama buyuk tenant'larda kapsamli. Fallback'e fallback: picklist fail olursa eski metod kullanilir.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ4 'duplicate sampling helper' diyebilir. Kabul: iki strateji intentional (picklist primary, lead-grouping fallback); deletion=behavior change (50-lead grouping bir kosulda hala lazim).

spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Picklist degerleri Zoho admin UI'da nadir degisir (nerdeyse statik); 5-dk yeterince fresh + Zoho rate limit dostu. Blueprint transition'lari ise admin Zoho'da daha sik tweaked (workflow tuning); 10-dk daha uzun cache. UX cards: stage editor sayfa acilir 5-dk taze yeter; user 5-dk icinde 2 kere stage mapping editle = ok. Discover buton iki cache'i ayri invalidate edebilir (lead-statuses ?refresh=true).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex 'cache TTL tutarsizligi' diyebilir. Kabul: Zoho admin UI semantik farkindan kaynakli (picklist nadir, blueprint sik degisir); ayri TTL business-driven.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Dashboard TS DTO'lar Shared C# DTO'lariyla manuel mirror — codegen YOK (P3-B1/B2/C/P4 pattern).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Proje genelinde DTO'lar elle mirror; bu paket scope'unda da ayni. ZohoLeadStatusDto + ZohoLeadStatusListResponse TS interface'leri Shared C# init-only record'lar ile camelCase serializer uyumu manuel.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex CQ8 'contract drift risk' diyebilir. Kabul: P4 paketi PASS aldi ayni pattern; codegen ayri scope.
